verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes a managed MCP server and an Agent Toolkit that let MCP-compatible AI assistants create checkouts, manage accounts, and process payments via natural-language-driven agents (sumup-docs-11, sumup-docs-25, sumup-docs-12, sumup-docs-43). This is first-party documentation only, with no independent or hands-on report confirming smooth natural-language operation in practice. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's natural-language workflows, and any evidence of a native NL command interface outside the MCP/agent-toolkit integration path.
